name: Shyvana
title: The Half-Dragon

P.name: Scalemail

effects.description: Innate: Shyvana generates Scalemail stacks from scoring takedowns against certain enemies. Large monsters and large minions grant 1 stack, while enemy champions and epic monsters grant 3.
Scalemail: For each stack, Shyvana gains 0.3 bonus armor and 0.3 bonus magic resistance.

P.notes:
Each Scalemail stack is worth  12.
 0.3 armor is worth  6.
 0.3 magic resistance is worth  6.
P.blurb: Innate: Shyvana generates Scalemail  stacks from scoring  takedowns against certain enemies. Large  monsters and large  minions grant a stack, while enemy  champions and epic  monsters grant more.

Q.name: Emberstrike

effects.description: Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's current cooldown by 0.5 seconds, and deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+ 1.1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health. Against non-champions, this effect deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200.

Active: Emberstrike can be cast twice in Human Form and thrice in Dragon Form. Each cast empowers Shyvana's next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and trigger an additional exclusive effect. After 1.5 seconds of using an Emberstrike attack, or immediately following a basic attack, the ability can be recast within and up to the next 4 seconds each time, before it incurs its cooldown. Shyvana gains 50 bonus range on all of her basic attacks while Emberstrike is active. The attacks deal 10 bonus physical damage against monsters.

First Cast: Shyvana slashes her claws, blasting a cone in the target's direction that deals modified physical damage to enemies hit. The damage to the primary target is affected by critical strike modifiers.
Second Cast: Shyvana slams her tail, dealing the same damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
Dragon Form Bonus — Third Cast: Shyvana takes a bite out of the target, dealing modified true damage. This damage cannot critically strike.
All casts reset Shyvana's basic attack timer.

Q.notes:
Applies  spell damage to the primary target (attack target) and  area damage to secondary targets. The passive on-hit damage applies  proc damage.
 Spell shield will not block any damage nor be consumed by the strikes.
The true damage is always equal to 150% of the pre-mitigation physical damage.
 Blind will negate the damage to the primary target, but not to any secondary targets.
PENDING FOR TEST: Interaction with parrying effects ( dodge,  block).
Only the last cast of Emberstrike puts Shyvana's basic attack on cooldown.
In Human Form, only Q2 will put it on cooldown; in  Dragon Form, only Q3 will.
This results in the same functionality as  Leona's  Shield of Daybreak and  Volibear's  Thundering Smash, effectively being a triple/quintuple attack reset.
Q.blurb: Passive: Shyvana's  basic attacks  on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's  current cooldown, and deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

W.name: Inferno Aegis

effects.description: Active: Shyvana shields herself for 2.5 seconds, with the shield strength increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion. For the same duration, she gains 25% bonus movement speed, increased to 43.75% while facing visible enemy champions.
After 1 second, Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.
Recast: Shyvana consumes the shield to explode, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
Dragon Form Bonus: If the explosion hits an enemy champion, Shyvana heals herself for 60 : 104.71 (based on level) (+ 4% : 8.47% (based on level) missing health).

W.blurb: Active: Shyvana  shields herself for a short time, with the shield strength increased for every nearby enemy champion. For the same duration, she gains  bonus move speed, increased while facing enemy champions. Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.

E.name: Molten Burst

effects.description: Active: Shyvana launches a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Dragon Form Bonus: The fireball is wider, can pass through enemies, and deals 25% increased damage. Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, and after reaching maximum range, the fireball sets an explosion upon the targets struck and at the location that applies the same effects. Molten Burst will also scorch the ground it touches beneath for 2 seconds. Enemies within a scorched field are dealt 3.75 / 5 / 6.25 (based on level) (+ 1.25% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds, for a total maximum damage of 30 / 40 / 50 (based on level) (+ 10% AP).Enemies may be damaged by only one scorched field at a time. Subsequent explosions against the same target deal 40% damage.

E.notes:
The fireball applies  area damage. In  Dragon Form, the explosion applies  area damage and the scorched field deals  persistent area damage.
In Dragon Form, both areas of effect will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.
Molten Burst will fail to go on cooldown if its cast time starts in  Dragon Form and ends in Human Form.(bug)
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
E.blurb: Active: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and  slowing them for a moment.

R.name: Dragon's Descent

effects.description: Passive - Fury: Shyvana generates Dragon Fury every 0.5 seconds while in Human Form. Her basic attacks and abilities also generate 1.25 Dragon Fury for each enemy damaged, up to once per enemy per cast instance and increased[ by 200% ][ to 3.75 ]during Dragon Form. Against non-champions damaged by abilities, the generated amount is reduced to[ 25%. ][ 0.3125 and 0.9375 Dragon Fury during Human Form and Dragon Form, respectively. ]Shyvana gains 1% bonus Dragon Fury generation from all sources per 1 ultimate haste. Shyvana gains 100 Dragon Fury upon learning Dragon's Descent.

Active: Shyvana transforms into Dragon Form and flies with displacement immunity to the target location, breathing fire in a cone along the way that deals magic damage to enemies hit and fears them for 0.75 seconds, as well as slows them by 99% for the same duration.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains bonus health, bonus attack range, and increased size. Her basic abilities are empowered to apply an additional effect. She maintains Dragon Form at a recurring cost of Dragon Fury, returning to Human Form once all Dragon Fury has been depleted.
100 Dragon Fury is required to cast this ability.

R.notes:
Dragon's Descent's  displacement immunity begins from the start of the cast time.
Ultimate haste acquired while Shyvana is dead does not grant bonus Dragon Fury generation until she respawns.
 Emberstrike's attack against the primary target will generate the full Dragon Fury amount even if they're a non-champion.
The attack's area of effect will generate reduced Dragon Fury for secondary targets damaged.

lore: Shyvana is a fearsome half-dragon warrior. Though she often appears humanoid, she also rules the skies as a dragon, incinerating her foes with fiery breath. Having saved the life of the crown prince Jarvan IV, Shyvana now serves uneasily in his royal guard, struggling to find acceptance among the suspicious people of Demacia.

skins.name: Original
skins.lore: Shyvana is a creature with the magic of a rune shard burning within her heart. Though she often appears humanoid, she can take her true form as a fearsome dragon, incinerating her foes with fiery breath. Having saved the life of the crown prince Jarvan IV, Shyvana now serves uneasily in his royal guard, struggling to find acceptance among the suspicious people of Demacia.

skins.name: Shyvana Ironscale
skins.lore: It made sense that Shyvana wanted to play a powerful dragon in Riftquest, but what surprised her party more was the joyful penchant for destruction that the game brought out in their staunchly disciplined friend. Descending upon the battlefield with glee, Shyvana Ironscale's roar alone sends enemies and figurines flying (and sometimes her allies, too).

skins.name: Boneclaw
skins.lore: Many hunters claim Shyvana holds an unfair advantage when it comes to slaying the giant beasts that roam the land. Shyvana herself cares little about their opinions, preferring instead to channel her rage into her true form—a massive, fire-breathing dragon… that proves the hunters' point.

skins.name: Darkflame
skins.lore: With her humanity burned away by the Darkflame, Shvyana wreaks havoc upon the battlefield. It is said that any enemy touched by her flame will have their very soul incinerated by its dark magics.

skins.name: Ice Drake
skins.lore: From the desolate reaches of the North, a dormant drake lay in rest. Upon Shyvana's arrival this behemoth awakened from its slumber and imbued her with the power of the frozen wastes. Now she stalks the tundra, searching for any foolish enough to cross her path.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive during a Worlds event.

skins.name: Super Galaxy
skins.lore: By far the most experienced of the entire Super Galaxy team, Shyvana is the leader her teammates sorely need. A transfer pilot from a different (but just as hyperbolically named) defense force, she does sometimes find herself at odds with her allies as much as her enemies—and periodically questions if the ten percent salary bonus was actually worth it.

skins.name: Ruined

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a Loot exclusive in the 2021 Sentinels event.
This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2021.

skins.lore: Shyvana's ruination brings a newfound darkness, as well as clarity. Turning swiftly against Demacia for its persecution of magic, and sinking into her more draconic emotions, she appears as an avenging beast of old, ready to topple Demacia for its ignorance.

skins.name: Immortal Journey

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2023.

skins.lore: For 100 years, the dragon Shyvana watched over the Sprouting Courage School's gardens, but after saving one of the monk's sons from drowning, she was allowed to train. Transforming into a human, she enjoyed the challenge this new form would bring. Unlike Soraka, Shyvana has no doubt about who she is: a protector of the strongest school of immortality.
